label: Music
title: Albums, song cycles, and vocal settings.

items.title: Soliloquies Vol. I
items.subtitle: A cycle of intimate vocal works built around solitary speech, memory, and inward argument.
items.shortDescription: Solitary speech and memory through the lens of classical and modern poetry.
trackList: To be, or not to be (Hamlet)
Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening (Frost)
items.credits: All tracks performed and produced by Vadym Tyemirov.
items.notes: A collection of vocal performances focusing on the 'soliloquy'—moments of profound internal dialogue and public speech. From the stoicism of Marcus Aurelius to the timeless words of Shakespeare and Milton.

items.title: Songs of Desire
items.subtitle: Longing, pursuit, and the unstable border between romantic address and self-invention.
items.shortDescription: A multi-track album about longing and self-invention.
items.credits: Produced and composed by Vadym Tyemirov.
items.notes: Songs of Desire explores the themes of pursuit and the construction of identity through romantic and introspective lenses.

items.title: Egyptian Nights
items.subtitle: Nocturnal atmosphere, mythic ornament, and theatrical voice.
items.shortDescription: A song cycle shaped by nocturnal atmosphere and theatrical voice.
items.credits: Written, produced, and performed by Vadym Tyemirov.
items.notes: A cinematic journey through urban nights and mythic archetypes. The album blends atmospheric soundscapes with grounded, often gritty, narratives.

items.title: Поющий Пастернак
items.subtitle: Russian-language album of vocal settings inspired by the poetic world of Boris Pasternak.
items.shortDescription: Vocal settings of Boris Pasternak's poetry.
trackList: Любить иных — тяжелый крест (To love others is a heavy cross)
Быть или не быть (To be or not to be)
items.credits: Vocal arrangements and performance by Vadym Tyemirov. Lyrics by Boris Pasternak.
items.notes: An exploration of Pasternak's lyrical intensity through modern vocal settings. The album preserves the literary heritage while adding a contemporary sonic layer.

items.title: Февраль. Достать чернил и плакать …
items.subtitle: Russian-language album centered on winter, language, melancholy, and poetic intensity.
items.shortDescription: Melancholy and winter through Russian poetry.
items.credits: Performance and production by Vadym Tyemirov. Lyrics by Boris Pasternak.
items.notes: A focused cycle dedicated to a single, iconic poem by Boris Pasternak, exploring its various emotional and rhythmic dimensions.
